name: @panoptes/cli
//: The build deviates from the root esbuild defaults (CODING.md, Build targets) because its output is not something node runs from this checkout: `deno compile` turns it into the executables a release attaches (docs/release.md).

bundle with thirdParty inlines every workspace package and every npm dependency, so the executable carries no node_modules. format esm because deno reads a bare .js file as an ES module. esbuild.config.mts stamps the workspace version in, which no static option can express.

declarationRootDir puts the declarations where tsconfig.app.json's own rootDir and outDir say they go. Without it the executor emits them under dist/apps/cli/src, and the typecheck target then reports TS6305 for a module imported from a sibling file.

test depends on this project's own build, not only on its dependencies, because main.spec.ts runs the bundle the build writes rather than the source (issue #33). Without the edge the spec reads whatever dist/main.js was left from an earlier run, or none at all.
